# The Water Cycle

## Evaporation

Water turns from liquid to vapor when heated by the sun.

## Condensation

Water vapor cools and forms clouds.

## Precipitation

Water falls as rain, snow, or hail.

## Collection

Water gathers in oceans, rivers, and lakes.
